object.description: The Mapping of Address and Port (MAP) object {{bibref|RFC7597}} {{bibref|RFC7599}} {{bibref|RFC7598}}. This object applies only to gateway devices that support IPv4 on the LAN side, include a {{object|#.NAT}}, and typically have only IPv6 connectivity on the WAN side. See the MAP Theory of Operation {{bibref|TR-181i2|Appendix XV}} for a description of the working of this MAP data model.
